Filtrer par catégorie

::: {.filter-right}
```{=html}
<select id="cat-select" onchange="filterCategory(this.value)">
  <option value="all">Toutes les catégories</option>
</select>
<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  var select = document.getElementById("cat-select");
  var links = document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing-category a.category");
  var seen = {};
  links.forEach(function (link) {
    var val = link.getAttribute("data-listing-category") || link.textContent.trim();
    if (val && !seen[val]) {
      seen[val] = true;
      var opt = document.createElement("option");
      opt.value = val;
      opt.textContent = val;
      select.appendChild(opt);
    }
  });
});

function filterCategory(val) {
  var links = document.querySelectorAll(".quarto-listing-category a.category");
  if (val === "all") {
    links.forEach(function(link) {
      var cat = link.getAttribute("data-listing-category") || link.textContent.trim();
      if (!cat) { link.click(); }
    });
    if (links.length > 0) { links[0].click(); }
    return;
  }
  links.forEach(function (link) {
    var cat = link.getAttribute("data-listing-category") || link.textContent.trim();
    if (cat === val) { link.click(); }
  });
}
</script>
```
